segments.speaker: me
segments.text: This is the planning session for the spring launch. We have six weeks, so let's lock channels and the asset list today.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Paid social is the backbone again. We're planning three creative concepts and testing them for the first week.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: For content, I want a launch post, two customer stories, and a short explainer video.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Can the video be done in six weeks?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: If we use the motion template from last year, yes.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: Events-wise, there's the retail tech conference in April. We have a small booth and one speaking slot.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. Let's make sure the talk lines up with the launch messaging.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: On the agency side, I want to flag the contract structure before we sign the next SOW.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: They're billing us at cost plus a thirty-eight percent margin on media, and their account lead told me their team gets a bonus pool tied to our spend, something like fifteen percent of the margin.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: That's wild. And our own bonus targets are tied to pipeline, so we're kind of paying them to make our numbers look expensive.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay, let's take the agency commercials offline with finance. Back to the plan.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Landing page copy is drafted. I need product to confirm the feature names before we finalize.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: I'll get you that list by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Speaker 4
segments.text: For email, we'll do a teaser to the existing customer list a week before, then the announcement day of.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: And a retargeting campaign for anyone who visits the pricing page during launch week.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Good. Who's owning the launch-day checklist?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thanks, Zainab. Let's meet again next Tuesday to review first drafts.
